name: funkey-os
description: FunKey-OS 2.3.0 (FunKey S retro handheld): a BR2_EXTERNAL tree on the FunKey fork of Buildroot 2021.02, external musl toolchain, 32-bit ARM
notes: Buildroot 2021.02 predates glibc 2.34: its host packages (m4 first) do not build on a current host, so the project names the ubuntu20.04 tool baseline (legacy worker pool, same image for the golden Job). No patches are applied.
